source_qa.note: x minus reference, MW, over overlapping hours; per-hour values for every source in source_compare.csv. bch5_raw is the uncorrected real-time page value.

valuation.us: Mid-C day-ahead peak price; off-peak hours priced at 0.8x (assumption)
valuation.offpeak_hours: US Pacific prevailing time: hour-ending 23-6 Mon-Sat, all Sunday, NERC holidays (New Year's, Memorial Day, Independence Day, Labor Day, Thanksgiving, Christmas; Sunday holidays observed Monday)

arbitrage_estimate.note: Breakdown of the headline total, computed from the same hourly flows and hub prices. Both lines are PART OF the total (not additional) and overlap each other; do not add them to the total or to each other. Not Powerex's actual trading profit (published only as multi-year ranges).

labels.timing_cad: Of the total above: gain from better-timed trades
labels.spread_cad: Of the total above: margin on matched import/export volume
labels.peak_only: Alternative valuation with the Mid-C peak price in every hour

assumptions.offpeak_hours: US Pacific prevailing hour-ending 23-6 Mon-Sat, all Sunday, NERC holidays
assumptions.applies_to: Mid-C (BC-US) price only; AESO pool price is already hourly

sources.label: BC Hydro 2025/26 Annual Service Plan Report (net trade table p.136, Appendix B p.64, MD&A p.25-26)
BC Hydro 2024/25 Annual Service Plan Report (Appendix B p.68)

different_measures_fy2026.note: Different measures, not like-for-like: tie-line flows include Powerex trading and other non-purchase flows valued at hub prices; BC Hydro's reported trade is its domestic purchases and sales at Powerex transfer prices. Ratios are descriptive only.

load_context.definition: BC Hydro Balancing Authority (BCHA) gross telemetered Control Area Load: hourly average MW for the BC Hydro balancing authority area, which covers British Columbia's interconnected grid. Generation is derived as load + net exports on the BC-US and BC-AB tie lines (the BA's interchange), so load = generation + net imports holds by construction.

statcan_check.note: Derived generation (BCHA load + net tie exports) vs Statistics Canada table 25-10-0015-01, BC total generation, all producers. StatCan also counts generation outside the telemetered BA load (e.g. off-grid and some industrial self-generation), so derived is expected to be a few % lower.

load_context.instantaneous: Not published: BC Hydro has no public 5-minute or instantaneous load/generation feed (the 5-minute real-time page has tie-line flows only), so peaks here are highest hourly averages.

load.label: BC load (BC Hydro balancing authority, hourly)
load.note: posted each business day for the previous day(s)

midc.label: Mid-C peak price (delivery day)
midc.note: later days carry this price forward
